overview.text: Today's AI developments highlight major operational shifts, market dynamics, and infrastructure updates across the ecosystem. Nvidia faces scrutiny amid allegations of engineering scarcity through funding AI startups to buy its GPUs, alongside internal petitions regarding leadership. Meanwhile, Anthropic experienced elevated errors affecting claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com, coinciding with discussions on the newly introduced Claude Mythos 5.2 system card. In research and releases, new physiological and neuroimaging foundation models expand medical capabilities, while OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet to enable agent purchases. These events collectively shape the technical and strategic landscape for researchers and founders navigating hardware availability, agentic workflows, and infrastructure reliability.

entries.title: A Cardiorespiratory Foundation Model Pretrained on Ten Physiological Signals for Perioperative and Critical Care
entries.summary: Arterial, venous, pulmonary artery and intracranial pressures and ventilator waveforms guide decisions in operating rooms and intensive care units, yet foundation models for physiological waveforms have been built almost entirely on the electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram.…
entries.why: A physiological foundation model extends critical care analytics beyond standard electrocardiograms.
